prototype_feel_reasons: Mobile intentionally uses a horizontally scrollable scene, but the partial right-edge cutoff initially makes the composition feel slightly unfinished before the swipe instruction is noticed.
The numbered speech labels and translucent lock markers overlap substantial portions of the detailed map, creating a busier, less art-directed composition.
The very large empty lower region makes the overall screen feel less deliberately balanced, especially on desktop.
issues: mobile/main waste-processing scene — the fixed-width scene is cut off at the right viewport edge, including part of the fourth-stage area — add a stronger horizontal-scroll affordance, reveal a deliberate preview sliver, or scale the scene slightly to improve the initial composition

main scene/gameplay overlays — clue labels and lock circles obscure portions of roads, buildings, and machinery that help users inspect the process — reposition labels into quieter areas and connect them to targets with short pointers

desktop/page composition — the illustrated interaction occupies only the top portion of a tall narrow column, leaving excessive unstructured space below — tighten the screen height or add a contained completion/progress area to balance the composition
